learnings: Speed register writes (addr 46) already ported into UI teleop loop by parallel worker — proportional speed K=1.2, min=80, max=500.
Added leader velocity feedforward to teleop speed formula: speed = K*|error| + FF*|leader_vel|, FF=0.6. Reads PRESENT_SPEED_ADDR (58) on leader bus each cycle.
STS3215 speed register format: bit 10 = direction, bits 0-9 = magnitude. Mask with 0x3FF for unsigned speed.
Encoder wrap detection already in teleop loop: halts joint if position jumps >1500 counts. Uses teleop_halted set.
Velocity read adds ~3ms per cycle (6 joints * 0.5ms) within 50ms budget at 20Hz — acceptable.

learnings: INCIDENT: cal save with 0-tick ranges overwrote leader calibration (elbow_flex became 4058-4058). Position mapping sent follower into desk.

Cal save hardened: refuses to save joints with <50 tick spread, only widens ranges (union of old+new), never narrows.
Always-on calibration: removed cal_active gate, ranges track continuously. Persistent to shared/cal_ranges_live.json, survives restarts.
Auto-assignment by P gain at startup: follower P=16, leader P=0. No manual assign_arm needed after restart.
Collision detection (P8): during teleop, if follower load > 350, freeze joint at current position. Unfreeze when load < 150.
Fast /api/positions endpoint added for recorder (reads from memory, not disk).

P9 (workspace-aware) added to safety principles: workspace limits in safety.json override calibration limits where more restrictive. Enforced in /api/move AND teleop loop via _apply_workspace_limits().
Three-layer position safety: P9 workspace clamp -> P3 calibration clamp -> P5 collision detection. Tested: sent elbow_flex=50, got clamped to 255.
World model insight: joint limits (calibration) != workspace limits (environment). Calibration is permanent, workspace changes when robot moves to a different table.
